UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a player's profile in the game, holding personal data, currency, and references to their owned heroes and teams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

inGameCurrency.description: The amount of in-game currency the player possesses.

experiencePoints.description: The total experience points accumulated by the player, influencing player level.

lastLoginDate.description: Timestamp of the player's last login.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

ownedHeroIds.description: References to heroes owned by this player. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Hero)

leagueRankingId.description: Reference to the player's current league ranking. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 LeagueRanking)

Hero.title: Hero
Hero.description: Defines a MOBA hero character with their base statistics, role, and abilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hero entity.

description.description: A brief description or lore of the hero.

role.description: The primary intrinsic role of the hero (e.g., 'Carry', 'Support', 'Tank').

rarity.description: The rarity level of the hero (e.g., 'Common', 'Rare', 'Epic', 'Legendary').

baseAbilityPower.description: The hero's base ability power for magical damage or healing.

abilityNames.description: A list of the hero's primary ability names.

imageUrl.description: URL to the hero's portrait or icon image.

PlayerTeam.title: PlayerTeam
PlayerTeam.description: Represents a team of heroes managed by a player for competitive play.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PlayerTeam entity.

name.description: The name of the player's team.

description.description: A short description of the team or its motto.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this team. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PlayerTeam)

rosterSlotIds.description: References to the TeamRosterSlots that compose this team's lineup. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N TeamRosterSlot)

strategyId.description: Reference to the strategy assigned to this team. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:1 Strategy)

TeamRosterSlot.title: TeamRosterSlot
TeamRosterSlot.description: Represents a specific hero assigned to a slot within a player's team, including team-specific attributes like level and assigned role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeamRosterSlot entity.

playerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam this roster slot belongs to. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N TeamRosterSlot)

heroId.description: Reference to the Hero assigned to this slot. (Relationship: Hero 1:1 TeamRosterSlot)

assignedRole.description: The specific lane or position role assigned to this hero within the team's strategy (e.g., 'Top Lane', 'Mid Lane', 'Jungler').

level.description: The current level of the hero specifically for this player's team context.

experience.description: The experience points accumulated by this hero specifically for this player's team context.

Strategy.title: Strategy
Strategy.description: Defines a pre-configured strategy or tactical approach for a player's team in automated matches.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Strategy entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the strategy (e.g., 'Early Game Aggression', 'Late Game Scaling').

description.description: Detailed description of the strategy's focus and tactical goals.

tacticsType.description: General type of tactics employed by this strategy (e.g., 'Push', 'Farm', 'Roam', 'Objective Focused').

focusPoints.description: Key areas or phases of the game this strategy emphasizes (e.g., 'Early Game', 'Mid Lane Control', 'Team Fights').

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Records the outcome and key details of a simulated MOBA match between two player-managed teams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

matchDate.description: Timestamp when the match was simulated.

team1PlayerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam that participated as Team 1. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N Match)

team2PlayerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam that participated as Team 2. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N Match)

winningPlayerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam that won the match. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N Match)

durationSeconds.description: The simulated duration of the match in seconds.

status.description: The current status of the match (e.g., 'Completed', 'Abandoned').

summary.description: A short summary or narrative of the match outcome.

matchStatisticIds.description: References to detailed statistics records for this match. (Relationship: Match 1:N MatchStatistic)

MatchStatistic.title: MatchStatistic
MatchStatistic.description: Detailed statistics for a specific hero within a specific team during a match.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MatchStatistic entity.

matchId.description: Reference to the Match this statistic belongs to. (Relationship: Match 1:N MatchStatistic)

playerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam this hero played for in the match. (Relationship: PlayerTeam 1:N MatchStatistic)

heroId.description: Reference to the Hero this statistic pertains to. (Relationship: Hero 1:N MatchStatistic)

kills.description: Number of enemy heroes killed by this hero.

deaths.description: Number of times this hero was defeated.

assists.description: Number of assists contributed by this hero.

goldEarned.description: Total gold earned by this hero during the match.

damageDealt.description: Total damage dealt by this hero to enemy heroes and structures.

damageTaken.description: Total damage taken by this hero from enemies.

healingDone.description: Total healing provided by this hero to allies.

creepScore.description: Number of enemy minions (creeps) killed by this hero.

towerDamage.description: Total damage dealt by this hero to enemy towers.

dragonsKilled.description: Number of Dragons killed or contributed to by this hero's team.

baronsKilled.description: Number of Barons killed or contributed to by this hero's team.

heraldsKilled.description: Number of Rift Heralds killed or contributed to by this hero's team.

towersDestroyed.description: Number of enemy towers destroyed or contributed to by this hero's team.

LeagueRanking.title: LeagueRanking
LeagueRanking.description: Stores a player's competitive ranking and statistics within a specific league season.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeagueRanking entity.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this ranking belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 LeagueRanking)

currentRank.description: The player's current position in the league rankings.

eloRating.description: The player's Elo rating, reflecting their skill level.

wins.description: Total number of matches won in the current season.

losses.description: Total number of matches lost in the current season.

ties.description: Total number of tied matches in the current season.

seasonIdentifier.description: A string identifying the specific season for this ranking (e.g., '2023-Season-Spring').

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp when the ranking was last updated.

definition.description: A collection used for Database Access Control (DBAC) to define administrators. A document's existence at `/roles_admin/{uid}` grants administrative privileges to that 'uid'.

params.description: The unique ID of the user (Firebase Authentication UID) who has administrative privileges.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for Moba Tactics Online prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by strictly adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates. 

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):** This is achieved primarily through pervasive denormalization where authorization context is copied into subcollection documents. For user-specific nested data like `PlayerTeam`, `TeamRosterSlot`, `Strategy`, and `LeagueRanking`, the `userProfileId` is denormalized, and implicitly confirmed by the path segment `userId`. This means security rules for these collections can directly check `resource.data.userProfileId == request.auth.uid` (or rely on the path `userId == request.auth.uid`), eliminating expensive and non-atomic `get()` calls to parent documents. 

For `Match` and `MatchStatistic` entities, which involve two different players, `team1OwnerId` and `team2OwnerId` (representing the `uid`s of the players owning the participating teams) are denormalized directly into each document. This allows security rules to evaluate access based on fields within the `resource.data` itself, e.g., `request.auth.uid == resource.data.team1OwnerId || request.auth.uid == resource.data.team2OwnerId`, without relying on hierarchical reads.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure facilitates secure `list` operations (Query Against Permitted Subset) by using appropriate structural segregation and denormalization:
1.  **Private Data:** Collections like `/users/{userId}/playerTeams` naturally support QAPs. A query like `/users/{request.auth.uid}/playerTeams` implicitly filters for the authenticated user's teams. Rules simply confirm that `request.auth.uid` matches the `userId` in the path.
2.  **Global Data:** `/heroes` is read-only for all, allowing direct unfiltered `list` queries without security concerns.
3.  **Collaborative Data:** For `/matches` and `/matches/{matchId}/matchStatistics`, the denormalized `team1OwnerId` and `team2OwnerId` fields are crucial. Clients can issue queries like `/matches?team1OwnerId={request.auth.uid}` or `/matches?team2OwnerId={request.auth.uid}`. Security rules will then verify that any document returned by such a query (or any `get` operation) belongs to the requesting user based on these denormalized fields. This enables efficient and secure listing of a player's relevant matches and their statistics without exposing other players' match data.

**DBAC:** The `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection implements Database Access Control (DBAC). Admin roles are determined by the *existence* of a document with the authenticated user's UID in this collection, removing the need for custom claims and simplifying rule logic. 

**Structural Segregation:** Data with different security postures is kept in separate collections. For example, player-specific data is nested under `/users/{userId}`, while global hero data is in `/heroes`. This prevents complex conditional logic within security rules.

**Access Modeling & Consistency:** Path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/...`) is consistently used for private user data. The naming conventions for path parameters (e.g., `{userId}`, `{playerTeamId}`) are descriptive and consistent. All authorization-critical fields (e.g., `userProfileId`, `team1OwnerId`) are explicitly named and consistently applied where needed.
